surfaces.name: Product interface
surfaces.purpose: User-facing product screens must carry explicit design context and verification evidence before release claims are made.

qualityGates.evidence: Reviewed product, audience, brand, and interaction context before changing the interface.
Foreground, background, focus, and disabled states were checked for readable contrast.
Core screens were checked at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.
Long labels, empty states, errors, and dense content were checked for clipping and overlap.
Animations and transitions were checked for purpose, timing, and reduced-motion behavior.
Interactive controls were checked for keyboard reachability, focus order, and visible focus.
Representative screenshots or visual-regression evidence were captured for changed surfaces.
A human reviewer accepted the interface evidence or recorded a bounded follow-up.

surfaces.failureMode: Block release claims until missing interface evidence is captured or an approved waiver is recorded.
surfaces.rollback: Revert the changed surface or ship behind a non-public review path when required evidence is missing.

surfaces.name: Public page
surfaces.purpose: Public-facing pages must prove readability, layout resilience, accessibility, and review evidence before publication.

qualityGates.evidence: Reviewed page objective, audience, offer, trust constraints, and brand direction before changes.
Text, controls, links, and focus states were checked for readable contrast.
The page was checked at narrow, medium, wide, and content-heavy viewport states.
Headlines, calls to action, cards, forms, and navigation were checked for overlap and clipping.
Motion was checked for purpose, performance, reduced-motion behavior, and non-blocking content access.
Links, navigation, forms, and dialogs were checked for keyboard access and visible focus.
Before/after screenshots or comparable visual evidence were captured for changed public sections.
A human reviewer accepted the page evidence or recorded a bounded follow-up.

surfaces.failureMode: Block publication claims until missing page evidence is captured or an approved waiver is recorded.
surfaces.rollback: Keep the previous published page, hide the changed section, or ship behind a reviewed preview path.
